title: Password Input
summary: Warns about Caps Lock, a non-Latin keyboard layout and pasted spaces as they happen, so a typo doesn't look like a wrong password.
description: Password field that warns as it happens about Caps Lock, a non-Latin keyboard layout (from the physical key vs the character typed) and leading or trailing spaces from a paste, with a one-tap trim and a press-and-hold or toggle peek.
catches: Non-Latin keyboard layout producing other characters
Pasted leading or trailing spaces, with a one-tap trim
limits: Caps Lock state is only known after a key event
Doesn't check strength or breaches; see Password Policy Input
a11y: Visible label; input is described by the hint and warnings
Peek button has an aria-label, aria-pressed and title; hold works with Space or Enter
Focus returns to the input after a fix
server: Rate-limit sign-in attempts on the server; these warnings only reduce honest mistakes.
